titulo.alumno:
«Косвенные вопросы с вопросительным словом»
Indirect questions with an interrogative word

intro: An indirect question keeps the interrogative word and uses the word order of a statement: Я не знаю, где она работает.

piezas.titulo: An indirect question keeps the interrogative word and uses the word order of a statement: Я не знаю, где она работает.
texto: An indirect question keeps the interrogative word and uses the word order of a statement: Я не знаю, где она работает.
The subordinate clause is set off with a comma; it does not keep the direct-question order, nor is a final question mark added automatically.

frases.estudio: Редактор спросил, когда будет готов перевод.
frases.alumno: The editor asked when the translation would be ready.

frases.estudio: Посетители хотели узнать, почему закрыли вход.
frases.alumno: The visitors wanted to know why the entrance had been closed.

pregunta.texto: Which word keeps the question in «he asked where she lives»?

opciones.explicacion: где keeps the information asked in the direct question.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Редактор спросил, когда будет готов перевод.»

frase.texto: Редактор спросил, когда будет готов перевод.

opciones.texto: The editor asked when the translation would be ready.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: The visitors wanted to know why the entrance had been closed.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: Посетители хотели узнать, почему закрыли вход

piezas.traduccion: The visitors wanted to know why the entrance had been closed.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
